episode_title: Thanksgiving Storm Aftermath, Black Friday Economy, Eisenkot's Coalition Talks
script_en: Thanksgiving Storm Aftermath, Black Friday Economy, Eisenkot's Coalition Talks.
Powerful storms left nearly a million customers without power on Thanksgiving and disrupted travel across much of the country, but conditions are expected to improve heading into the weekend.
Americans are expected to spend a record amount this holiday season, even as inflation forces many shoppers to cut back on other expenses to afford gifts.

Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot could unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as early as next week, but divisions among his potential coalition partners could make it difficult to keep a new government together.
